thread:
mike: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API capacity planning. TL;DR: supply risk for H100s from vendor A + APAC customs lag means we need a short-term mitigation plan for April-May surge. Posting rough numbers, want opinions on mix (buy / short-term lease / cloud burst).

tara: Can you drop the forecast numbers? need to see hours and peak concurrency assumptions.

mike: Yep. Raw forecast (very conservative):
```
- Baseline q2 token-hour demand growth: +28% vs Q1
- Peak concurrent requests projected: 12.5k (95th pct)
- GPU-hours needed (in-hosted): 78k GPU-hours/month in April, 95k in May
- Preferred hardware: 50% H100, 50% A100 (for cost parity + legacy models)
```

diego: Vendor A just told us lead time for H100 replenishment is 10–12 weeks + customs buffer in APAC 2–3 weeks. So any buy placed now hits us late May/early June.

jen: Given that, I recommend a 3-part plan: 1) short-term cloud burst capacity in APAC for April-May, 2) 3-month lease tranche for H100s to cover peak (negotiable return), 3) staggered outright buys to lock price for Q3.

sam: Cost sketch (rough):
```
- Buy H100 effective monthly cost (amortized): $12.5k / GPU-month
- Lease H100 short-term: $18k / GPU-month
- Cloud-burst (on-demand p-ro): $24k / GPU-month but zero capital and fast spin-up
- Expected token cost delta if we move 30% of throughput to A100 quantized: ~ -18% GPU-hours
```

mike: Important operational constraints: cross-region KV cache warming takes ~8 hours for large prefix sets; if we burst to cloud, we must route with sticky circuit to avoid huge cold starts. Also network egress costs from APAC cloud region will be non-trivial.

tara: Can we reduce cold-start by shipping local KV snapshots to burst fleet? legal/policy check needed for customer data.

diego: Yes we can ship sanitized prefix caches (no PII) to burst pool. Need Storage + infra automation to sync snapshots hourly. I estimate ~30–40GB per region for top prefixes.

jen: Ops checklist if we go hybrid-burst:
- pre-stage sanitized KV snapshot to burst pool
- deploy inference container with same quantization kernels
- route 10% traffic for 1h smoke, measure latency/cost
- scale to 30–40% if stable

sam: Financially, a 6-week short lease for 120 H100 equivalents (~10% headroom) + 20% cloud burst cap keeps us under the 95th pct SLA cost target vs full buy. Modeling attached in the spreadsheet (not included here).

mike: Risk table (short):
```
- Procurement delay (high): delays >6 weeks -> short leasing + burst needed
- Customs hold in APAC (med): adds 2–3 weeks -> prefer cloud burst for APAC peak
- Price spikes on spot (med): cap spot use at 25% of burst pool
- KV cold-start impact (high): mitigated by staged snapshots and sticky routing
```

tara: From capacity perspective, can eng-sre automate pre-staging and sticky routing by next Tuesday? that's the gating item.

diego: I can build the pre-stage job and a sticky routing flag in the router by Monday EOD, but will need 2 reviewers for infra changes.

mike: Good. Action items:
- diego -> pre-stage snapshot job + router sticky flag (due Mon)
- jen -> negotiate 3-month lease options with vendors, push for return flexibility (due Wed)
- sam -> finalize financial model + break-even for buy vs lease vs burst (due Tue)
- tara -> legal check on snapshot contents & region egress policy (due Tue)

capacity-bot: [alert] cluster-headroom nominal 15% across hosted-west and hosted-east. Rolling capacity test scheduled 1964510000.

mike: OK planning wise. If legal OKs snapshots, we run a smoke on Wednesday in APAC dev and then decide on a 6-week lease tranche. Any objections? :thinking_face:

jen: No objections. I'll push leasing terms with early-return clause and escalate pricing floor.

tara: I'll confirm legal by EOD Tue.

diego: I'll post a quick runbook for the burst job once PRs are up.

mike: Thanks — we'll reconvene Thu after numbers come in. :thumbsup:
